## Mo ta
Mo ta ngan gon nhung thay doi trong PR nay.

## Loai thay doi
- [ ] Feature moi
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Refactoring
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] CI/CD
- [ ] Khac

## Lien ket Issue
Closes #(so issue)

## Screenshots / Videos
Dinh kem anh/video neu co thay doi UI.

## Checklist
- [ ] Code tuong thich voi coding conventions
- [ ] Da tu-review code cua minh
- [ ] Da them comments cho code phuc tap
- [ ] Khong tao ra warnings moi
- [ ] Da them tests (neu can)
- [ ] Tat ca tests hien tai van pass
- [ ] Lint va format pass

## Ghi chu cho Reviewer
Thong tin bo sung cho reviewer.
